outputs.name: bar
outputs.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value, if(from_unit == 2, value / 10.197, if(from_unit == 3, value / 14.504, value / 100)))

outputs.name: m_head
outputs.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 10.197, if(from_unit == 2, value, if(from_unit == 3, value * 0.703, value * 0.102)))

outputs.name: psi
outputs.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 14.504, if(from_unit == 2, value * 1.422, if(from_unit == 3, value, value * 0.145)))

outputs.name: kpa
outputs.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 100, if(from_unit == 2, value * 9.81, if(from_unit == 3, value * 6.895, value)))

steps.label: bar
steps.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value, if(from_unit == 2, value / 10.197, if(from_unit == 3, value / 14.504, value / 100)))

steps.label: m
steps.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 10.197, if(from_unit == 2, value, if(from_unit == 3, value * 0.703, value * 0.102)))

steps.label: psi
steps.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 14.504, if(from_unit == 2, value * 1.422, if(from_unit == 3, value, value * 0.145)))

steps.label: kPa
steps.expr: if(from_unit == 1, value * 100, if(from_unit == 2, value * 9.81, if(from_unit == 3, value * 6.895, value)))
